text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But that's not what Tracen Academy's all
about!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hey—inside voice. But yes, I agree.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day after Ms. Kashimoto took up
her role
as substitute director, and the
gymnasium is full
of displeased students
booing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An hour ago, an assembly was held to
welcome
her to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, a word from our new temporary
director,
Ms. Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, students. My name is Riko
Kashimoto,
and I was appointed to the
academy just
yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I will be taking over Director Akikawa's
duties for
the time being. I look forward
to getting to know
you all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Though I must say, my first impression
when I
arrived was that you are all
incredibly...
undisciplined.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I've witnessed an overreliance on solo
training,
excessive tardiness, and gossip
during breaks.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
There are even trainers who are unaware
of their
own students' sleeping habits,
indicating a
disconnect in their
relationship.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
This is not so much the students' fault,
but that of
their trainers' negligence.
Above all, this
environment was fostered
by Director Akikawa's
leniency.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
As such, I have devised a new training
program
based on thorough
management—I call it
Operation
Oversight.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I will begin by overseeing your training
schedules
and meals, and eventually
move on to managing
every aspect of
your private lives.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
These measures will serve not only to
increase
your capabilities, but also to
lower the risk of
injuries.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Umm... What's she saying, Rice?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Well... I guess we won't be able to snack
on ice
cream at night anymore? I think?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Why?!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I will also be suspending the Unity Cup,
which I
hear had been recently
reinstated.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No way! What's she talkin' about?!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You're all in a stage of life where your
emotions
are volatile, and placing you
into teams may
cause you to make
illogical and emotional
decisions.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
As a preventative measure to avoid any

team-related tomfoolery, it seems
prudent to
cancel such team-oriented
programs.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's not like we'll lose our minds if we get
put into
teams! Having teammates to
support us will—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
A thought experiment, then. Let's say a
particular
team engages in an excessive
amount of
supplementary training.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
They have no ill intentions and only
want to work
hard as a team in order to
claim victory.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
However, one of them pushes herself too
hard
and injures herself to the point of
being unable to
run.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Had she been on her own, she might
have realized
her limits, but because she
got carried away by
loyalty to her team,
she overworked herself.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: If that isn't rash behavior, then what is?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well... I mean...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of preventing such
tragedies, I am
banning all team events
and will manage your
well-beings as
thoroughly as possible.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I rest my point.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The room falls silent in the face of Ms.

Kashimoto's absolute decree.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Operation Oversight will be
implemented as soon
as possible. Be
prepared for future changes. This
is your
only warning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The assembly began with such optimism,
but ends
in chaos.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the countdown to the
implementation of
Ms. Kashimoto's
totalitarian management system
begins.
